description: Returns the link to start an order with Cheap NY Publication for a service, prefilled with the LLC's name when given. Nothing is charged here: the customer reviews the price, agrees to the terms and pays on our secure checkout. Use only when the user says they want to go ahead.

dos_id.description: The LLC's DOS ID from lookup_new_york_llc, so the checkout opens on that exact record.

llc_name.description: The LLC's exact name, to prefill the publication checkout.

route.description: Publication only: lower_cost_county (the LLC's county is moved to a lower-cost county) or direct (publish in its own county). Default: whichever costs less.

name: start_order
title: Start an order
